title: The (local) geometry of oscillatory integrals on manifolds: Dimension three
summary: Sogge studied Kakeya problems on two extreme types of three dimensional Riemannian manifolds: Manifolds with the most symmetries (manifolds of constant sectional curvature) and manifolds with the least symmetries, which he called manifolds with chaotic curvature and variably curved manifolds. In the same paper, Sogge proposed studying manifolds with intermediate symmetry, such as (locally) symmetric spaces.
